scope: Preview and optionally update only source/test pins of one explicit generated mull-confined-v1 manifest; preserve all other fields. No registration, payload execution or evidence production.

verification.independent_review: No concrete production blocker. Corrected duplicate-key test to use an otherwise valid generated manifest.

limitations: Only the exact confined Mull profile is supported; no native Python/Rust refresh parity.
Explicit file selection neither checks nor changes registry membership.
Cooperating writers use a parent lock; revalidation is not kernel compare-and-swap against hostile same-UID changes.
Refresh does not authenticate a producer, execute tests or validate existing receipts.
No matched speedup, model token reduction, task-success benefit or host adoption is claimed.
